def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find seed and direction: walls are full lines of 8; water moves perpendicular to them, away from its edge
    seed=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2][0]
    # detect orientation: if there are full horizontal 8-rows -> move down; vertical cols -> move right
    horiz=any(all(v==8 for v in row) for row in g)
    vert=any(all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H)) for c in range(W))
    water={(seed[0],seed[1])}
    if horiz:  # move down
        dr,dc=1,0; perp=[(0,1),(0,-1)]
    else:      # move right
        dr,dc=0,1; perp=[(1,0),(-1,0)]
    steps=0
    while water and steps<200:
        steps+=1
        for (r,c) in water: out[r][c]=2
        # move forward
        moved={(r+dr,c+dc) for (r,c) in water}
        moved={(r,c) for (r,c) in moved if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W}
        for (r,c) in moved: out[r][c]=2
        blocked={(r,c) for (r,c) in moved if g[r][c]==8}
        free=moved-blocked
        if not blocked:
            water=free; continue
        # spread in perpendicular directions from blocked cells on current line
        occ=set(moved)
        for (r,c) in blocked:
            for pr,pc in perp:
                rr,cc=r+pr,c+pc
                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                    occ.add((rr,cc))
                    if g[rr][cc]!=8: break  # opening ahead in travel dir? opening means next forward cell passable
                    rr+=pr; cc+=pc
        for (r,c) in occ: out[r][c]=2
        # water falls forward from cells whose forward cell is passable
        water=set()
        for (r,c) in occ:
            fr,fc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=fr<H and 0<=fc<W and g[fr][fc]!=8:
                water.add((fr,fc))
        # also free-moving water continues
        water|=free
        # dedupe: positions in occ whose forward passable -> next water at forward cell
    return out
